## What we do
We are ISO 14001:2015 environmental management system (EMS) consultants. We help organisations build their EMS and prepare for certification by an accredited certification body (CB). The certificate is issued by the CB after its own audit, not by us.

## Services
- ISO 14001 environmental management system consulting
- Gap analysis against ISO 14001:2015
- EMS documentation: environmental policy, aspects and impacts register, legal requirements register, objectives, operational controls, emergency preparedness and response
- Staff awareness training and internal auditor training
- Internal audit support and management review facilitation
- Preparation and support for the certification body audit (Stage 1 documentation review and Stage 2 implementation audit)
- ESG reporting framework setup and carbon baseline measurement
- Integrated management systems combining ISO 14001 with ISO 9001 and ISO 45001

## Consulting packages (as published on https://esgiso.com/#pricing)
| Package | Organisation size | Consulting fee |
|---|---|---|
| SME | Under 50 employees, single site | RM 13,000 |
| Professional | 50–200 employees, up to 3 sites | RM 22,000 |
| Enterprise | 200+ employees, multi-site operations | Custom quotation |

- Certification body (CB) audit fees are quoted separately based on your chosen CB.
- The first consultation is free.
- Package inclusions are listed on https://esgiso.com/#pricing and https://esgiso.com/iso-14001-cost-malaysia

## How an engagement works
1. Free first consultation
2. Gap analysis against ISO 14001:2015
3. EMS documentation development
4. Implementation and staff training
5. Internal audit and management review
6. Certification body audit (Stage 1 and Stage 2), carried out by the accredited CB you choose

A target date is agreed with you after the gap analysis; it depends on your organisation's readiness and the certification body's audit schedule.

## About ISO 14001
- ISO 14001:2015 is the International Organization for Standardization's standard for environmental management systems.
- It is a voluntary standard and does not require ISO 9001 as a prerequisite.
- Certificates are issued by accredited certification bodies such as SIRIM QAS International, BSI, TUV SUD, Bureau Veritas and SGS.
- A certificate is typically valid for three years, with surveillance audits in the intervening years and a recertification audit at the end of the cycle.
